step-1.text: Pick the spot and find what is behind the wall: a stud, brick or drywall. The screws for the wall are not included, because they depend on that.

count-1.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-2.text: Hold the wall fitting up, put a level on it, and mark the holes. Drill, plug if needed, and screw the fitting to the wall. Level matters more than anything here.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 wall fitting and 4 screws.

step-3.text: Slide the shelf over the prongs, all the way back until it touches the wall.

step-4.text: From underneath, drive the two small locking screws up into the fitting. Now it cannot slide off.

done.text: Shelf is up. Keep the heavy stuff near the wall end of the bracket, and enjoy the floating look.
